## Summary

Zephyr Point Media Ltd (policy CC-1481): theft of a 3D printer and filament stock from a locked van at a shared workshop on Tanner Row. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 6,264 dollars. Three points in the file need confirming (see Coverage analysis).

## Facts

Zephyr Point Media Ltd reported the loss on 20 April 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss was theft from a locked van at a shared workshop on Tanner Row [notice of loss]. The items are a 3D printer [invoice 1] and filament stock [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 22 April 2026 under reference CR/2026/4169 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at the premises named in the schedule, and at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy]. The items were in a locked van at the workshop [notice of loss], [police report]. The file does not include the policy schedule and does not say whose van it was, so custody or scheduled premises should be confirmed.

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply. It removes cover for theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared space unless the equipment was in a locked container or locked room. The workshop is a shared space [notice of loss], but the items were in a locked container [police report], [policy].

Exclusion 7.5 does not apply on the file as it stands. It removes cover where theft is alleged and the loss was not reported to the police within seven days [policy]. The police report is dated 22 April 2026, two days after the notice of loss dated 20 April 2026 [police report], [notice of loss]. The file does not state the date of the theft, so that date should be confirmed to complete the seven-day check.

Exclusions 7.3 (wear and tear) does not apply: the loss is alleged theft, not gradual deterioration [notice of loss], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted, subject to confirming the three points above: custody or scheduled premises, the date of theft, and the schedule.

## Reserve

The reserve is 6,264 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (5,181 dollars and 1,083 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. Clause 9.1 applies an excess only where the schedule shows one, and none applies where the schedule shows none [policy]. The schedule is not in the file and no excess appears in the extract, so no excess is deducted; this should be checked against the schedule.
